summary: Kerb beside a sports club, with cars parked and homes across the road.

drivers.seclusion: West side backs onto club greens and fence; nearest homes are across the road, about 27 m or more.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars are parked along this kerb in both images, so a van can pull in; short stretch near a crossing.
drivers.traffic: Through road with an intersection just east; steady passing traffic.
drivers.convention: Other cars park here, so a van will not stand out.

flags: Busy road with junction and zebra crossing nearby
Mapped gates 6 m and 18 m away have a way round
sun_shade: Open to the sky; trees to the north end give some shade; afternoon sun from the west over the club.

best_section.where: west kerb on Clarence Road beside the bowls club, north of the crossing
